test_assurance_observations.title: Lookup-token test does not isolate key dependence from salt dependence
test_assurance_observations.scope: Test-claim strength only; no production defect or exploit established.
test_assurance_observations.explanation: The test title claims a keyed rather than plain-hash lookup token. It checks equality across repeated writes in one vault and inequality after creating a separate store with a different key. The separate-store comparison also changes the salt, explicitly acknowledged by the source comment. These assertions establish stable tokens within a profile and different tokens across these two profiles, but they do not independently establish key dependence.
test_assurance_observations.mitigation: Add a deterministic test that holds salt and normalized address constant while changing the key, with an independently derived expected token or a fixed known-answer vector. Preserve the existing cross-profile and fresh-IV assertions.
test_assurance_observations.limitation: This is a bounded observation about the reviewed test. It does not assert that the production derivation is unkeyed or that the complete repository lacks additional coverage.

test_assurance_observations.title: KDF preflight test infers zero derivation work from elapsed time
test_assurance_observations.scope: Test-claim strength only; no production defect or exploit established.
test_assurance_observations.explanation: The test requires invalid parameter variants to reject with the fixed validation message and requires the entire loop to finish within two seconds. Its title and trailing comment additionally claim rejection before any derivation. Elapsed time is not a direct assertion of the number of KDF calls, and it varies with the execution environment.
test_assurance_observations.mitigation: Observe the KDF boundary through an injected dependency or mock and explicitly assert zero invocations for invalid parameter variants; retain a separate bounded-work check if useful.
test_assurance_observations.limitation: The actual validation ordering may already be correct. This review neither ran the tests nor re-audited the production KDF implementation.

review_summary: No new production vulnerability or behavior defect established from this test-only batch.

QR coverage includes actual raster decoding for Unicode round trips, exact classifier metadata, size and format rejection, secret/bearer warning preservation, runtime primitive-only inputs, and all warning-flag combinations in the most complete assigned variant.

Deployment and release tests cover fail-closed verification statuses, omitted credentials/referrers, bounded fetch/read cleanup, build key validation, signed bundled manifests, declared-origin mismatch, and source/bundle policy checks. These are inspected assertions, not observed test results.
Tag tests cover ciphertext storage, authenticated record binding, migration, key zeroization, optimistic concurrency, lock cancellation, session replacement and stale-profile writes.
The confirmed BROWSER-01 issue was not duplicated, and no claim is made that a catching Pay route test is absent.
